_documentation.purpose: Defensive comp pool for the matchup-channel rebuild (Module D).
_documentation.buckets: Four position-grouped-against buckets: vs_QB, vs_RB, vs_WR, vs_TE. The offensive position of the player determines which bucket's comps are looked up at inference time.
_documentation.weights: 1.0 placeholder for features passing R>=0.55 Y/Y stability (single-year, no rolling smooth). 0.5 placeholder for features near-strict (R~0.30-0.55) included to give the BallTree enough dimensions to discriminate -- coverage scheme is the only feature family that passes strict R>=0.55, so vs_RB pool would be empty without the relaxed-tier features. NCA fitter (parallel worktree) will tune weights next session.
_documentation.y_y_audit: /tmp/phase0_defense_yoy_results.csv and /tmp/phase0_defense_rates_yoy.csv from the defensive stability audit (NFL 2023-2025 single-year team-grain aggregates, n=64 pair observations per feature).
_documentation.relaxed_tier_acknowledged: def_man_pct (r=0.417), def_zone_pct (r=0.373), def_rush_yaco_allowed_per_att (r=0.354 unweighted ~ 0.31 weighted), def_rush_explosive_pct (r=0.32). These are included to provide bucket-specific signal beyond the single coverage-shell axis. Strict R>=0.55 with no relaxation would leave vs_RB pool empty.
